milestone.title: Fix Deps tab infinite loading in Formulae panel

intent.outcome: Deps tab in the Formulae panel renders the dependency list for the selected formula within a reasonable time (no infinite 'loading' state).

problem.description: Smoke test 2026-08-01 (M08) found that switching to the Deps tab in the Formulae panel causes the view to hang in a 'loading' state indefinitely. Adjacent tabs (Used by, Files) render correctly; only Deps is broken. Failure observed manually on macOS, real Homebrew install, lazybrew built from wip@4366b36.

in_scope: Identify why the Deps tab never completes its fetch.
Fix the underlying bug (could be: tea.Cmd never sent, message never handled, dep-tree parsing issue, cache key collision).
Add a teatest E2E flow that selects a formula, switches to Deps tab, asserts deps text appears within a timeout.
Update smoke checklist: Deps tab item -> [x].
out_of_scope: Refactoring the Formulae panel beyond the Deps fix.
Fixing other tabs (Used by, Files render correctly per smoke).

acceptance_criteria.description: Selecting a formula and switching to the Deps tab renders the dep list within 5 seconds.
acceptance_criteria.verification: manual: open lazybrew, select formula git, switch to Deps tab, observe dep list appears within 5s (no infinite loading); OR automated: teatest flow TestDepsTabLoads exits 0

acceptance_criteria.description: Selecting a different formula updates the Deps tab to that formula's deps.
acceptance_criteria.verification: manual: with deps shown for A, press j/k to B, observe deps update; OR automated: teatest flow asserts deps change on selection

acceptance_criteria.description: Regression coverage: a teatest flow guards this fix.
